# ggindex

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/discindo/ggindex/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/discindo/ggindex/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/discindo/ggindex/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/discindo/ggindex)
<!-- badges: end -->

`{ggindex}` marks selected points of a ggplot2 plot with numbered markers
and explains the numbers in a legend, as on an annotated map.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `{ggindex}` from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

```{r}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("discindo/ggindex")
```

## Example

Map `info` to the description that goes in the legend. The entries are
numbered in the order they appear in the data; map `label` to choose the
numbers yourself.

```{r example}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggindex)

sites <- data.frame(
  x = c(6, 7, 8, 9, 10),
  y = c(6, 9, 7, 10, 8),
  name = c("Library", "Main hall", "Sports centre", "Cafeteria", "Car park")
)

ggplot(sites, aes(x, y, info = name)) +
  geom_focus() +
  theme_minimal()
```

`geom_sf_focus()` does the same on maps made with the sf package:

```{r map, fig.height = 3.5}
nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
nc <- sf::st_transform(nc, 32119)
nc_large <- nc[nc$AREA > 0.2, ]

ggplot(nc) +
  geom_sf(fill = "grey90", colour = "white") +
  geom_sf_focus(aes(info = NAME), data = nc_large) +
  scale_info_discrete("Largest counties") +
  theme_void()
```

Map `focus` to number only some observations, and draw the rest with
`geom_point()`. The markers take the standard `colour`, `fill`, `shape` and
`size` aesthetics, so regular ggplot2 scales apply. Here the most efficient
car of each cylinder class is numbered by its overall rank and filled by
class:

```{r focus}
cars <- mtcars
cars$model <- rownames(cars)
cars$rank <- rank(-cars$mpg, ties.method = "first")
cars$best <- cars$mpg == ave(cars$mpg, cars$cyl, FUN = max)

ggplot(cars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_focus(aes(label = rank, focus = best, info = model, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  scale_fill_brewer("Cylinders", palette = "Set2") +
  scale_info_discrete("Best in class") +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lbs)", y = "Miles per gallon") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Map `label`, `focus` and `info` in `geom_focus()` when the plot has other
layers: layers inherit the mapping of `ggplot()`, and their observations would
also appear in the legend.
